Default value 7 rendered in direct_billing_and_authorization_terms_c993f5d9 and named ("the option's initial authorization days"). Equivalent; nothing added.

- Factor recalibration_days_owed ($2000.00 -> 2; $1000.00 to below $2000.00 -> 1; else 0; supplement required) -> adas_recalibration_days_beecc10a incl. inclusive boundaries. Equivalent.
- Factor recalibration_scheduling (method: Select = max; outside Select = start + recal + 1; otherwise sum) -> recalibration_scheduling_by_shop_d9988e54 (incl. "otherwise" as "No shop kind recorded on an estimate"). Equivalent. Assembly "authorized days are the repair days plus the package days": carried by "the days an accepted larger-class partner rental is authorized for rest on its repair days" (recalibration_scheduling_by_shop) + "Package days are added to the days … authorized for" (package_days_on_larger_class_rentals). - Factor package_rental_days (6 -> 2; 4/5 -> 1; below 4 -> none) -> package_days_on_larger_class_rentals_a8736c2a (names Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package and that the rank is the package allowance, not the option's). - Overwrite: retired surface present (see base). Tool contract (owner user, 7 params, enum classes, return) = hub table. Equal.

## bijection_verdict
**PASS** (task 0). No omission, rewrite or addition found across the base policies, the four extended policies (every tier of all 18 declared factors), the six overwrites, the three prerequisites and the four tool contracts.
Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts): (1) the rental_evt_authorization overwrite retires the first-authorization days clause wholesale, but its replacement covers only accepted larger-class rentals; the KB faithfully writes "The days an authorization covers are now set under the current basis for authorized days", leaving a plain (non-upgrade) first authorization with only the initial-authorization-days parameter — scope of the overwrite is a source matter. (2) rental_ext_extension_day_room's rule ("is extended when the repair shop confirms … or documents a parts delay") does not say how the documentation is evidenced; in task 0 only the caller's word exists.
